title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen against Gemini 3.8 Flash and Argon
summary: Google says Hydrogen beats Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and, against Gemini 3.8 Flash, finishes tasks 2.5 times faster with 12% to 23% fewer tokens in partner testing.

sources.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash model page (Intelligence Index v5.0.1)
Gemini 4 Hydrogen model page (Intelligence Index v5.0.1)
Gemini 4 Argon model page (Intelligence Index v5.0.1)

claims.text: Scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its default setting, ahead of Argon's 50

ref.note: Intelligence Index v5.0.1, both at high.

claims.text: Uses 12% to 23% fewer tokens than Gemini 3.8 Flash
claims.scopeNote: Google's range comes from unnamed partners' workflows. This uses output tokens across the Intelligence Index and tests the bottom of the range.

ref.unit: million output tokens across the index

claims.text: Finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash at its default setting
claims.noRefNote: Artificial Analysis does not publish an end-to-end task time for Gemini 3.8 Flash at high.

observations.text: Gemini 3.8 Flash is now marked deprecated by Artificial Analysis, which recommends Hydrogen in its place.

livePack.note: Starter tasks plus multi-step efficiency tasks.

extraTasks.prompt: A train leaves at 09:40 and arrives at 13:05 the same day. How many minutes is the journey? Answer with the number only.
How many positive integers below 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5? Answer with the number only.
If today is Wednesday, what day of the week will it be 100 days from today? Answer with the day name only.
A shop gives 20% off, then a further 10% off the reduced price. What is the total discount as a percentage of the original price? Answer with the number only.
Which is the largest of these: 3/7, 0.45, 4/9, 0.43? Answer with the value exactly as written in the list.
Return only JSON with keys "po" and "total" (total as a number, in rupees) for this order: "PO-7781 for 12 units at Rs 1,250 each."
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in the word "transformation"? Answer with the number only.
